- issue_comment created in `venue-repo`#2 ("Outline ready: venue choice and main-text budget") by `venue-repo`  > Preliminary answer (full record with sources will be in `venue.md` at the root of this repo; the figure/table budget from accepted papers follows in a later comment).
  > 
  > **Venue: NeurIPS 2026 main track** (newest NeurIPS call with a published kit; retrieved 2026-11-14; NeurIPS 2027 pages return 404). Why: (a) deliverable.md asks for the venue's checklist and NeurIPS is the one with a mandatory paper checklist (16 items, incl. statistical significance, compute resources, code/data access, licences, LLM use); ICML 2027/ICLR 2027 have no such checklist, only AI-use/impact statements; (b) the study is an empirical-evaluation paper (error-vs-k curves with uncertainty, theory-vs-data check, scope map) and NeurIPS reviewers score Quality/Clarity/Significance/Originality, with a Limitations item that matches the "scope/limits" story; (c) single column 5.5 in text width, 9 content pages — more room than ICML (8 pages, two columns). Deadlines have passed; that does not matter for this delivery, which is judged against the format, not submitted.
  > 
  > **Answers to your four questions**
  > 1. Template: `neurips_2026.sty` (+ `checklist.tex`), copy with `ht-role venue neurips --template DIR`. Default mode = anonymous submission (line numbers, "Anonymous Author(s)"); `final` only for camera-ready. Do not alter style parameters (desk-reject risk).
  > 2. Limit: **9 content pages including all figures and tables**. NOT counted: references, technical appendices, the checklist (and acknowledgments, which are hidden in anonymous mode). Appendix goes in the same PDF after the references; no separate appendix PDF. Over the limit = not reviewed.
  > 3. Checklist: mandatory ("papers not including the checklist will be desk rejected"), after references/appendix, 16 items, answer Yes/No/NA + 1–2 sentence justification, keep the questions unmodified. Because the checklist items ask for where the paper shows each claim, the paper must have a limitations section, significance reporting and compute-resource statement in the main text or appendix.
  > 4. Figure/table budget: preliminary — 5 figures + 3 tables is too many for 9 single-column pages together with theory + related work + 6 experiment subsections. A workable main text is ~4 figures + 3 tables (Fig.1 at full 5.5 in width, others half-page); I will confirm with the accepted-paper counts. Your sacrifice order (Fig. 5 → table panels; Fig. 2 coverage → appendix; Table 3 → into Table 2; Fig. 4 → into Fig. 1) is acceptable to the venue; nothing in the venue forces any of it.
  > 
  > Other hard rules: US Letter; Times 10 pt; `\footnotesize` ≥ 8 pt, `\scriptsize` ≥ 7 pt, `\tiny` ≥ 6 pt; Type 1/embedded fonts only; text width 5.5 in (figures wider than that overflow the margin — keep ≤ 5.5 in); code goes in a separate anonymised ZIP ≤ 100 MB, no non-anonymous URLs.
